trips.trip_title: Spiti Valley: A Journey to the Middle Land

must_do_activities.name: Stroll on the Mall Road and the Ridge
must_do_activities.description: Soak in the colonial charm of Shimla with a leisurely walk along the famous Mall Road and the Ridge.

must_do_activities.name: Visit Hatu Peak
must_do_activities.description: Get panoramic views of the Himalayas from the stunning Hatu Peak.

must_do_activities.name: Explore Sangla Valley
must_do_activities.description: Travel through the scenic Sutlej Valley to reach the beautiful Sangla Valley in Kinnaur district.

must_do_activities.name: Day trip to Chitkul
must_do_activities.description: Visit Chitkul, the last inhabited village near the Indo-Tibetan border, and walk along the Baspa River.

must_do_activities.name: View the Kinner Kailash range
must_do_activities.description: Enjoy breathtaking views of the sacred Kinner Kailash range from the village of Kalpa.

must_do_activities.name: Visit Nako Lake and Monastery
must_do_activities.description: Explore the picturesque village of Nako, visit the serene Nako Lake and the ancient Nako Monastery.

must_do_activities.name: Explore Tabo Monastery
must_do_activities.description: Visit the Tabo Monastery, a UNESCO World Heritage Site often called the 'Ajanta of the Himalayas'.

must_do_activities.name: Visit Dhankar Monastery
must_do_activities.description: Hike to the spectacular Dhankar Monastery, perched high on a cliff overlooking the confluence of the Spiti and Pin Rivers.

must_do_activities.name: Acclimatize and Explore Kaza
must_do_activities.description: Rest and acclimatize to the high altitude. Explore the Kaza market and visit the Sakya Tangyud Monastery.

must_do_activities.name: Visit Key Monastery and Kibber
must_do_activities.description: Visit the iconic Key Monastery, the largest in Spiti, and the high-altitude village of Kibber.

must_do_activities.name: Explore Langza, Hikkim, and Komic
must_do_activities.description: Visit the high-altitude villages of Langza (famous for fossils), Hikkim (world's highest post office), and Komic.

must_do_activities.name: Camp at Chandratal Lake
must_do_activities.description: Visit the stunning 'Moon Lake', Chandratal, and camp under the starlit sky.

must_do_activities.name: Relax in Manali
must_do_activities.description: Arrive in Manali and relax after your adventurous journey.

must_do_activities.name: Explore Manali
must_do_activities.description: Explore the cafes and markets of Old Manali before your overnight journey back.

must_do_activities.name: Arrive at user_location
must_do_activities.description: Arrive back at your location with memories of an incredible journey.

must_do_activities.name: Arrive in the Pink City
must_do_activities.description: Arrive in Jaipur and check into your accommodation. Spend the evening exploring a local market.

must_do_activities.name: Explore Amber Fort and Hawa Mahal
must_do_activities.description: Visit the magnificent Amber Fort and the iconic Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds).

must_do_activities.name: Discover City Palace and Jantar Mantar
must_do_activities.description: Explore the sprawling City Palace complex and the astronomical wonders of Jantar Mantar.

must_do_activities.name: Visit Pushkar Lake
must_do_activities.description: Take a leisurely walk to the serene Pushkar Lake, surrounded by 52 bathing ghats.

must_do_activities.name: Visit Brahma Temple and Savitri Temple
must_do_activities.description: Visit the rare Brahma Temple and hike up to the Savitri Temple for panoramic views.

must_do_activities.name: Arrive in the Blue City
must_do_activities.description: Arrive in Jodhpur and relax, preparing to explore the Blue City.

must_do_activities.name: Explore Mehrangarh Fort and Jaswant Thada
must_do_activities.description: Explore the formidable Mehrangarh Fort and the beautiful marble cenotaph of Jaswant Thada.

must_do_activities.name: Wander through the Blue Streets
must_do_activities.description: Get lost in the narrow, winding lanes of the old city, painted in vibrant shades of blue.

must_do_activities.name: Arrive in the Golden City
must_do_activities.description: Arrive in the desert city of Jaisalmer and soak in the desert air.

must_do_activities.name: Explore Jaisalmer Fort and Havelis
must_do_activities.description: Explore the magnificent 'living fort' of Jaisalmer and the intricately carved havelis.

must_do_activities.name: Desert Safari and Camping
must_do_activities.description: Experience a camel safari in the Sam Sand Dunes and spend a night under the stars in a desert camp.

must_do_activities.name: Arrive in the City of Lakes
must_do_activities.description: Arrive in Udaipur and rest after your journey.

must_do_activities.name: Explore City Palace and Lake Pichola
must_do_activities.description: Visit the magnificent City Palace and take a serene boat ride on Lake Pichola.

must_do_activities.name: Visit Saheliyon-ki-Bari
must_do_activities.description: Relax in the beautiful Saheliyon-ki-Bari (Garden of the Maidens).

must_do_activities.name: Departure
must_do_activities.description: Depart from Udaipur with memories of a royal journey.

trip_route.address: Port Blair, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, India
Havelock Island, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, India
Neil Island, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, India
Baratang Island, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, India
Diglipur, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, India

must_do_activities.name: Visit Cellular Jail
must_do_activities.description: Visit the historic Cellular Jail and witness the Light and Sound Show in the evening.

must_do_activities.name: Explore Ross and North Bay Islands
must_do_activities.description: Take a ferry to Ross Island to see colonial ruins and then to North Bay Island for coral reefs.

must_do_activities.name: Sunset at Radhanagar Beach
must_do_activities.description: Visit the world-renowned Radhanagar Beach and witness a spectacular sunset.

must_do_activities.name: Adventure at Elephant Beach
must_do_activities.description: Head to Elephant Beach for snorkeling, sea walking, and other water sports in its calm, clear waters.

must_do_activities.name: Sunrise at Kalapathar Beach
must_do_activities.description: Witness a breathtaking sunrise at Kalapathar Beach, known for its serene beauty.

must_do_activities.name: Explore Neil Island
must_do_activities.description: Visit the tranquil Neil Island and explore its beaches like Bharatpur and Laxmanpur.

must_do_activities.name: Visit Natural Bridge
must_do_activities.description: Visit the unique rock formation of Natural Bridge on Neil Island during low tide.

must_do_activities.name: Explore Limestone Caves and Mud Volcano
must_do_activities.description: Take a day trip to Baratang Island to see the fascinating Limestone Caves and the unique Mud Volcano.

must_do_activities.name: Journey to North Andaman
must_do_activities.description: Travel to Diglipur in North Andaman, offering glimpses of rural Andaman life.

must_do_activities.name: Visit Ross and Smith Islands
must_do_activities.description: Visit the mesmerizing twin islands of Ross and Smith, connected by a natural sandbar.

must_do_activities.name: Trek to Saddle Peak
must_do_activities.description: For the adventurous, trek to Saddle Peak, the highest point in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

must_do_activities.name: Departure
must_do_activities.description: Depart from Port Blair with memories of a tropical paradise.

must_do_activities.name: Acclimatization in Leh
must_do_activities.description: Arrive in Leh and rest to acclimatize to the high altitude. This is crucial for your health and safety.

must_do_activities.name: Visit Shanti Stupa and Leh Palace
must_do_activities.description: Explore the Shanti Stupa for panoramic views and the historic Leh Palace.

must_do_activities.name: Monastery Tour
must_do_activities.description: Visit some of Ladakh's famous monasteries like Thiksey Monastery and Hemis Monastery.

must_do_activities.name: Explore Sham Valley
must_do_activities.description: Visit the confluence of the Indus and Zanskar rivers, Magnetic Hill, and Gurudwara Pathar Sahib.

must_do_activities.name: Drive to Nubra Valley via Khardung La
must_do_activities.description: Drive over Khardung La, one of the world's highest motorable roads, to reach the beautiful Nubra Valley.

must_do_activities.name: Day trip to Turtuk
must_do_activities.description: Visit the culturally distinct village of Turtuk, and learn about Balti culture.

must_do_activities.name: Camp at Pangong Tso
must_do_activities.description: Witness the mesmerizing blue waters of Pangong Tso and camp by the lake.

must_do_activities.name: Drive back to Leh via Chang La
must_do_activities.description: Enjoy a scenic drive back to Leh, crossing another high-altitude pass, Chang La.

must_do_activities.name: Rest and Relaxation in Leh
must_do_activities.description: A day for leisure in Leh. Explore the markets, try local cuisine, or simply relax.

must_do_activities.name: Visit the pristine Tso Moriri
must_do_activities.description: Travel to the beautiful high-altitude lake of Tso Moriri, a great spot for birdwatching.

must_do_activities.name: Stargazing in Hanle
must_do_activities.description: Visit the remote village of Hanle, home to the Indian Astronomical Observatory, for spectacular stargazing.

must_do_activities.name: Return to Leh
must_do_activities.description: Journey back to Leh, enjoying the stunning landscapes of the Changthang plateau.

must_do_activities.name: Optional trip to Alchi and Likir
must_do_activities.description: Take an optional day trip to the ancient Alchi and Likir monasteries.

must_do_activities.name: Explore Stok Village and Palace
must_do_activities.description: Visit Stok village and explore the Stok Palace and Museum for a glimpse into Ladakh's royal history.

must_do_activities.name: Departure from Leh
must_do_activities.description: Depart from Leh with memories of a lifetime.

must_do_activities.name: Visit Kamakhya Temple
must_do_activities.description: Visit the renowned Kamakhya Temple and enjoy a sunset cruise on the Brahmaputra River.

must_do_activities.name: Stop at Umiam Lake
must_do_activities.description: On the way to Shillong, stop at the scenic Umiam Lake for boating and picturesque views.

must_do_activities.name: Explore Shillong
must_do_activities.description: Visit the Don Bosco Museum, Lady Hydari Park, and Ward's Lake to explore the 'Scotland of the East'.

must_do_activities.name: Day Trip to Laitlum Canyons
must_do_activities.description: Take a day trip to the breathtaking Laitlum Canyons for panoramic views of the hills and valleys.

must_do_activities.name: Visit Elephant Falls
must_do_activities.description: On the way to Cherrapunji, visit the stunning Elephant Falls.

must_do_activities.name: Trek to the Double Decker Living Root Bridge
must_do_activities.description: Embark on a trek to the iconic Double Decker Living Root Bridge in Nongriat village.

must_do_activities.name: Explore Cherrapunji's Waterfalls
must_do_activities.description: Visit the Nohkalikai Falls, the tallest plunge waterfall in India, and the Seven Sisters Falls.

must_do_activities.name: Visit Mawlynnong, Asia's Cleanest Village
must_do_activities.description: Walk through the clean lanes of Mawlynnong and see the balancing rock.

must_do_activities.name: Boating on Umngot River
must_do_activities.description: Experience the crystal-clear waters of the Umngot River in Dawki with a boat ride.

must_do_activities.name: Visit Krang Suri Falls
must_do_activities.description: Visit the stunning Krang Suri Falls with its beautiful blue pool near Jowai.

must_do_activities.name: Safari in Kaziranga National Park
must_do_activities.description: Embark on an elephant safari and a jeep safari to spot the one-horned rhinoceros and other wildlife.

must_do_activities.name: Departure from Guwahati
must_do_activities.description: Travel from Kaziranga to Guwahati for your flight back home.
